title: Procedure 1102 (RTIC ALPR Systems) — version history and posting location
summary:
Asks for:

1. Any SOP, general order, Lexipol procedure, or equivalent operational document governing ALPR use by Real Time Information Center (RTIC) personnel — including but not limited to "Procedure 1102 — ALPR Systems" (published on or about March 6, 2026) — with all versions and revisions, identifying the current operative version.
2. Records sufficient to show where each such procedure is publicly posted, including any City or Department website URL.

If any responsive document was superseded, withdrawn, renumbered, or removed from public access, the request asks for the superseded version and any record reflecting that change.

policy_promises.quote: ALPR usage and privacy policy shall be implemented, available to the public, and posted conspicuously
policy_promises.tests: Where is the RTIC-specific ALPR procedure posted, and how does its availability line up with the conspicuous-posting requirement?

prior_pra_refs.note: Same version-history-plus-posting request aimed at SOP 205. The agency's 2026-03-03 response admitted the SOPs were not posted and committed to publishing them. This request applies the same questions to the RTIC-specific procedure.
Followed up on the W012198 posting commitment.
Production included an SOP version dated 3/6/2026 and a 'Re: Change in SOP' email — version-change context for the March 2026 procedural changes this request asks to be documented.

filed_because: Procedure 1102 — ALPR Systems (Lexipol, published on or about March 6, 2026) is the first operational procedure identified for RTIC ALPR use, but it is not linked from the department's License Plate Readers page — it surfaces only through the city's site-wide search. The request asks for the procedure's full version history, the current operative version, and a record of where it is publicly posted.
